verdict.rationale: Apple's docs make specific gaming claims (dynamic caching, ray-tracing engine, 'smoother gameplay' in Cyberpunk 2077) and community mentions general GPU compute gains, but no independent hands-on game benchmarks (FPS, frame-time data) corroborate these claims. Missing for 10: independent frame-rate benchmarks in actual games, comparison vs prior-gen/other GPUs in real titles, and confirmation of sustained boost/thermal behavior under gaming load.
